mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_view_history ( username, content_id, title, first_image, addr1, viewed_at ) VALUES ( #{username}, #{contentId}, #{title}, #{firstImage}, #{addr1}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE viewed_at = NOW(), title = #{title}, first_image = #{firstImage}, addr1 = #{addr1}
mapper.select: SELECT content_id AS contentId, title, first_image AS firstImage, addr1, viewed_at AS viewedAt FROM user_view_history WHERE username = #{username} ORDER BY viewed_at DESC LIMIT 10
